headline: Argentina Tax Revenue Growth Slows to 0.7% Real Increase in October
summary: Argentina's tax collection slowed in October, registering a 0.7% real increase as income and social security taxes sustained the result, while VAT suffered its twelfth consecutive month of real decline.
why: Tax collection data serves as a key indicator of domestic economic activity, consumer consumption health, and government fiscal balance in Argentina.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Slowing real tax revenue growth points to subdued domestic economic activity.
